text:
Anya: AM microbatch handoff — quick status. What I did: landed kv eviction throttle patch into canary, ran a 1k-smoke bench against split-embed models. Blockers: seeing p95 spike on long-seq requests. Today: digging into kernel backpressure + batching refactor merge.

Sam: thanks — can you paste the bench numbers and the exact command you ran?

Anya: bench summary pasted below. baseline vs canary (same infra):
``nBaseline: p50=18ms p95=240ms p999~720ms;
Canary(kv-evict-throttle): p50=19ms p95=340ms p999~980ms;
cmd: ./tools/bench --model gpt-4x-slim --seq 2048 --concurrency 50 --qps 400 --runtime canary
```

Priya: hmm that p95 delta smells like occasional slot steal or queue head-of-line. @Anya did you capture kernel logs for the higher latency buckets? :thinking_face: 

Anya: yep — attaching the tail of the kernel log that lines up with the biggest p95: 
``
[2026-06-07T09:23:11Z] batcher: allocated slot id=42 shard=3 wait_ms=112 drop=false
[2026-06-07T09:23:11Z] kernel: prefetch miss, kv_retrieval_ms=78
[2026-06-07T09:23:11Z] batcher: flush triggered size=64 latency_ms=220
[2026-06-07T09:23:11Z] kernel: kv_eviction_throttle=on stall_ms=180
```

Anya: local repro reduced p95 after enabling slot-limiter and lowering max-batch to 48, but canary still shows spikes under long-seq microbursts.

Maria: i'll run a targeted microburst run at 15:00 PT against the same canary config and add perf counters (slot occupancy + queue depth). Will report results here.

eng-sre: FYI — I increased canary shard capacity by +1 on hostpool-2 so latency noise should be lower for the next run.

Sam: thanks. quick code review ping for the batching refactor: PR #4389 has the limiter change and a small KV cache call order tweak. @Priya can you eyeball the ordering change? low-risk but want an extra pair of eyes.

Priya: will do this morning, should be able to review before 12:30.

ops-bot: Canary deploy kicked: kv-evict-throttle v1.2 -> canary (hosts: hp-2-11, hp-2-12). Logs will be available at https://ci.redwood/kanary/kv-evict-throttle/1.2

Anya: noted. If microburst run still shows p95 > 500ms after Maria's run, plan is to rollback throttle and toggle slot-limiter + revert max-batch to 64 while we iterate.

Sam: fine with rollback plan. keep us posted. :thumbsup:

Maria: running now, i'll paste numbers in here in ~10m.

Anya: thanks — also leaving a quick grep command for correlating batcher flushes to high-latency traces:
``
rg "batcher: flush" logs/canary/*.log | rg "latency_ms >= 200" -n
```

Maria: microburst finished — results: p50=20ms p95=360ms p999=1.05s; noticed spikes coincide with KV retrieval ms > 60 and burst qps>450. Uploading full trace to the shared bucket.

Sam: ok that narrows it. let's keep throttle on but prioritize reducing KV retrieval tail (cache prefetch tuning).

Anya: will start a prefetch policy tweak branch and open an eval harness for long sequence prompts. Might also add a small prefix cache for split-embed models.

Priya: thanks all — will finish the PR review and approve if small docstrings are added.

eng-sre: if you need extra capacity to repro at scale, @eng-sre can allocate a transient test pool. Reply with requested qps+hosts.

Anya: requesting +2 hosts for a 1k qps smoke later today (ETA 16:30 PT). I'll file the transient pool ticket now.

Sam: sweet. good handoff — we'll follow up in the afternoon.
